data.boundary: C5 year-by-year browse. File names identify author surnames and year only; titles need the paper or another channel. Per-year coverage: 1994: 35 files; 1996: 28 files; 1997: 20 files; 1998: 31 files; 2000: 38 files; 2001: 47 files; 2002: 70 files; 2003: 75 files; 2004: 61 files; 2005: 78 files; 2006: 53 files; 2007: 82 files; 2008: 60 files; 2009: 44 files; 2010: 58 files; 2011: 0 files.
failures: The icad.org directory root lists 1994, 1996-1998 and 2000-2011; the 2011 directory is empty. No listing for 1992 or for 2012 onward was reachable: the SMARTech series pages need JavaScript, its REST API returned HTTP 400/500 for search, item and relationship requests, its OAI-PMH ListRecords returned HTTP 500 and then reset the connection, and dblp's ICAD index served a bot-protection challenge that was not bypassed.
data.interface: Apache directory index pages fetched with curl from the workspace shell; raw pages retained under exports/icad-listing/

pagination.detail: Every listed year directory was read in full, but no listing exists for 1992 or 2011 onward on this host.
